conflicts.note: The M League now runs August to May with 22 matches per club; the 2026-27 season is the current one. The old calendar-year habit dates from the Myanmar National League era.
Correct: the MNL was rebranded as M League in August 2026, with a new logo and trophy. Sponsor name Grand Royal M League.

notes: 12 clubs, double round robin, 22 rounds. Bottom two relegated to the M2 League (formerly MNL-2), top two promoted from it; the M2 League is not modelled, so MYA1 is closed_down in our data. 2026-27 has ten clubs from 2025-26 plus Chinland and Myawady promoted. Shan United have won seven of the last eight titles, which makes the league very top-heavy but does not change its shape. Season dates and round count taken from the league article; the 2026-27 season page carries no independent table yet, hence medium confidence.
